about: A window's popups as it moves to a display of another scale (ADR 0018; the audit in docs/react-native-android-adaptation.mdx, "Popups following their window"): PopupWindowProbe (sample/PopupWindowProbe.tsx) on a 1280x720 display at 1 with, right of it, a 1600x1000 display at 1.25. With its menu open, the shell moves the window onto the second display: the window is asked for frames at 1.25 and the menu goes with it, at the same place against its trigger (334 and 172 logical pixels from the window's corner on both), and is drawn at 1.25 (120 logical pixels wide, its content's width as its own layout root lays it out, 150 by 70 device pixels; the same size on both, so the compositor places it again without asking it to resize), keeping the keyboard; its rows take their presses there. Moved back, the menu is drawn at 1 again. A tooltip goes across with its window the same way. popup-window-displays-scaled.json is the same with the displays the other way round (the primary at 1.25). Each step checks the popups' rectangles and their frames' pixels, the window's, the compositor's focus, what each surface was delivered and exactly what React heard.

steps.name: a press on the page: the window is the active one, on the first display
the menu opens under its trigger, drawn at 1
the shell moves the window onto the second display: the menu goes with it, at its trigger, drawn at 1.25, the keyboard still its
a row is chosen there: the menu closes, the window has the keyboard
the menu opens again on the second display, drawn at 1.25
moved back onto the first display: the menu goes with it and is drawn at 1 again
the tooltip shows under its button
the window goes onto the second display: the tooltip goes with it
